A MORE HUMAN WAY TO LEARN

Everyone starts somewhere.
Everyone learns differently.

There is no single right way to learn. Some of us listen, some read, and some need a little more space to focus. Use the blue accessibility button to make this page work better for you.

Take the first small step →
TRY CLOSED CAPTIONS

Three videos. Three ways to try CC.

Turn on Closed Captions in the accessibility panel, close the panel, and play a sample. Turn CC off to hide its captions. Keep the player volume on to compare spoken and silent sections.

01 · SPOKEN VIDEO · 16 SECONDS

Video with voice

English narration with matching captions. You should hear the words and see the same words below.

02 · SILENT VIDEO · 10 SECONDS

Video without voice

This video has no audio track. Its captions describe the visual scene; they are not spoken words.

03 · MIXED VIDEO · 18 SECONDS

Voice and silent sections

Hear a spoken introduction, watch a silent interval, then hear the ending. Captions change to match each section.

Nature footage: MDN CC0 flower clip. Sample narration uses a synthetic English voice. Captions are supplied with these videos.
